- Profile Page: https://narayanpresence.com/founder

## Core Methodology: The P.A.U.S.E. Framework
- P — Pause: Catch the thought loop while running without judgment.
- A — Acknowledge: Name emotions and bodily sensations without suppressing them.
- U — Understand: Separate what happened from the narrative and expectations added.
- S — Shift: Reframe perspectives and choose an intentional response over a reaction.
- E — Establish: Anchor what works into daily routine and sustainable decisions.
- Methodology Page: https://narayanpresence.com/methodology

## Core Offerings
- 1-to-1 Clarity Coaching: Guided reflective space for executives, professionals, and individuals. (https://narayanpresence.com/coaching)
- 1 AM Reset Blueprint: 3-day practical live intensive to calm nighttime mental loops and overthinking. (https://narayanpresence.com/workshops)
- Presence Academy: Structured courses including Clear Mind & Life Clarity (6 weeks), Emotional Awareness (4 weeks), and 21-Day Conscious Living. (https://narayanpresence.com/courses)
- Books & Products: Toolkits, daily reflection journals, and audio meditations. (https://narayanpresence.com/products)
- Presence Circle: Peer practice community and ongoing monthly alignment. (https://narayanpresence.com/community)
